**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

The Agreement contains no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification right binding Mortgage Logic. I checked the planner's candidates (§ 8 Client covenants, § 5 Compensation) and then every remaining section — § 2 Licence/Hosting Services, § 6 Documentation and Disputes, § 10 Confidentiality and §§ 12–30 — plus targeted searches for audit, inspect, records, verify, examine, monitor and facility-access language. All negative.

The only verification mechanic runs in our favour: § 6 entitles Client to supporting documentation for charges and to contest them. The closest TrueLink-side right, § 8(f)'s reserved ability to implement technical mechanisms against spamming, operates on TrueLink's own hosted Interface and is not an audit of Client, nor does it grant access to Client systems or records. No walk-away trigger (unlimited/unannounced audits or remote access to our systems) exists.

Accordingly there is nothing to constrain, and I deliberately did not propose the preferred parameters — inserting frequency, notice and cost limits would manufacture a TrueLink audit right that does not exist and would weaken us. I have noted for the file that if TrueLink later seeks verification, we hold at once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor under confidentiality, TrueLink's cost absent 5% underpayment, and no direct system access.
